about_the_game:
Upon encountering a mystical mirror, Ravenlok is whisked away to a whimsical world plagued by the sinister darkness of a tyrannical queen. Destiny awaits all in an unforgettable and heartfelt adventure.

  • By the creators of critically-acclaimed adventure “Echo Generation”
  • Fantasy Reimagined - Delve into a mystical, whimsical realm
  • Action RPG - Battle monsters and bosses with real-time combat
  • Enchanting Story - Meet curious creatures and complete quests to fight tyranny!
  • Distinctive Visuals - A 3D pixel art aesthetic with a cinematic touch
  • Ethereal Music - Emotive orchestral score to accompany the adventure
  • The grand finale of the Cococucumber Voxel Trilogy

THRILLING ACTION ADVENTURE

Battles against fearsome beasts and formidable monsters using real-time combat. Wield your sword and shield, and use the magical skills bestowed to you, along with an arsenal of bombs, to vanquish foes in epic boss encounters!

ENCHANTED WORLD

Meet curious creatures and help them with their troubles to fight back against the encroaching darkness. Discover the whimsical Mushroom Forest, tackle puzzles in the Mask Mansion and unravel the mysteries of the Labyrinth in a wonderful world turned upside down!

GRAND FINALE

By the creators of critically-acclaimed adventure “Echo Generation'', this enchanting fairytale marks the grand finale of the Cococucumber Voxel Trilogy. Immerse in a delightful and captivating indie game filled with heart.

name: Ravenlok: Legendary Edition

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 2.0 Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA GTX 900 Series or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 3.0 Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA GTX 10 Series or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey in Ravenlok, an action-packed fairytale adventure about a young heroine destined to fulfill a perilous prophecy.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian
